title: Polynomial-time 3-colorability of $P_t$-free graphs with one induced odd cycle length
statement:
For any integer $t$ and any odd integer $k$, let $\mathcal{G}_{t,k}$ be the class of graphs that are $P_t$-free and whose induced odd cycles all have length $k$. **Polynomial-time 3-coloring conjecture.** For any fixed $t$ and $k$, the 3-coloring problem for $\mathcal{G}_{t,k}$ can be solved in polynomial time.

This claim concerns the complexity of 3-coloring a restricted graph class, motivated by results on graphs with prescribed induced cycle lengths. The source gives no resolution status for this statement.
source_name: Yidong Zhou, Mingxian Zhong and Shenwei Huang, “3-Coloring P_t-Free Graphs With Only One Prescribed Induced Odd Cycle Length”, arXiv:2512.06367 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.06367

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of December 2025). “This is proved by Gy\'{a}rf\'{a}s and is best possible considering $G=K_{2r+2}$.”
